summary: Persist refresh episodes with clock-injected age transitions and target coalescing

replay.detail: Refresh state is read from runtime.refresh claims; existing projections are unchanged.

schema.detail: Adds the system-only runtime.refresh claim kind using the existing log, without new tables.

rules.detail: One active episode per seat/incumbent; transactional updates require its exact operation ID. Pre-seal target changes preserve first-pending age. Post-seal changes supersede and block advancement, permitting a fresh operation. Convergence resolves without restart.

compatibility.detail: Refresh envelopes are versioned; unsupported versions and unknown episode fields are rejected. Older readers do not recognize runtime.refresh claims. No detection, actuation or configuration changes.

manual.detail: No enablement or operator action required.

recovery.detail: Age, ordered effect identities and execution provenance survive reopening; failed execution remains unresolved and can escalate.
